claim: Conditional on the same upstream generic-grid, negligible-height, full-rank, and private-valuation hypotheses as the baseline, the full rank-two final algebraic witness can be reduced to an 8-by-4 grid (32 selected edges) by projectivizing the eight additively normalized right-hand differential coefficients.
assumptions: The upstream generic-grid transcendence inequality applies after adjoining the four anchor positions and a coefficient field of transcendence degree at most seven.
For a left point generic over that coefficient field, the upstream private odd valuations exist for all four radicands.
The full-rank branch has two nonparallel anchor displacement vectors and all four scalar differences A-A'_ell are nonzero.
The ambient field has characteristic zero and the anchors used for the additive gauge are distinct.
